messages:
olivia: Heads up — seen a cascade where eviction of tenant-A prefixes caused a long splay of demotions across two slabs, which then triggered prefetch churn for tenant-B. Not full outage but 3x tail latencies for a minute.

alex: ugh. any indicators on whether this is a race in the handoff path or just a backpressure amplification? :thinking:

jamal: early look at traces shows repeated demote->prefill->evict loops. looks like the demote token was handed off while a prefill was in-flight, so we ended up re-evicting recent entries.

infra-bot: deploy 1715006800 by jamal completed to canary (node-7).

sasha: can we get the eviction chain length metric? last time we only had per-evict counts, not the chained count.

olivia: agreed — we need `evict_chain_length` and `evict_origin` (tenant vs system-rebalance) ASAP. also `prefill_inflight` gauge would help.

alex: quick mitigation idea: if demote happens and `prefill_inflight > 0` then delay final eviction commit by small window (100-300ms) to avoid IO amplification. cheap and reversible.

jamal: that buys immediate relief but doesn't fix correctness when ownership actually transfers. we need idempotent handoff so a demote+handoff+prefill conflict cannot re-create a hot loop.

maya: propose a small change to the handshake semantics: add a handoff generation id (hand_gen) that accompanies the demote token. prefill operations carry the hand_gen they observed and only commit if hand_gen matches current owner. if owner bumped, prefill is treated as stale.

sasha: basically make prefill conditional on ownership epoch. nice. avoids double-apply.

olivia: summary of short vs long fixes:
- short: eviction-delay-on-prefill (100-300ms) + add metrics (evict_chain_length, evict_origin, prefill_inflight)
- medium: hand_gen on demote tokens + prefill validation
- long: refactor demote/handshake to separate liveness tokens from evict decisions (move to two-phase: intent vs commit)

alex: small telemetry queries we should add now:
```
sum(evict_chain_length) by (node)
avg(prefill_latency_ms) by (tenant)
rate(evict_origin{origin="handoff"}[5m])
```

jamal: I'm worried about two-phase commit adding latency to cold handoffs. we should make commit fastpath: if no prefill_inflight observed, commit immediately. only go through two-phase if we detect inflight prefill or high contended slab.

olivia: agreed — make two-phase opt-in based on heuristics. default to optimistic fastpath.

infra-bot: ticket created: RW-12345 "cascade-evict splay — metrics + short mitigation" assigned to jamal, due 3d.

maya: engineering checklist for RW-12345:
- add `evict_chain_length`, `evict_origin`, `prefill_inflight` metrics (jamal)
- implement eviction-delay flag behind runtime config (alex)
- hand_gen proof-of-concept branch (maya)
- canary rollout plan and smoke queries (olivia)

alex: for canary, will roll to 5% nodes with `evict_delay=200ms` and watch `evict_chain_length` spike down.

jamal: POC of hand_gen: will use `uint64` monotonic counter per prefix owner stored in slab metadata. prefill will read owner+hand_gen at start and verify before write. if mismatch, prefill becomes noop.

olivia: decision for now: implement short mitigation + metrics this week, start hand_gen POC next week. if POC looks clean, plan RFC for handshake-two-phase in 2 sprints.

sasha: assign me for the observability dashboard, I can add heatmap and alerts for chain_length > 2 and prefill_inflight > 0.

maya: one more note — ensure metrics include `evict_reason` label (hotset_spill, admin_rebalance, tenant_eviction) so alerting doesn't trigger on planned rebalances.

olivia: thanks all. jamal/alex please post PRs and canary timeline in this thread. :thumbsup:

jamal: will do — starting metric PR now.

alex: prepping a small runtime toggle + docs.

olivia: will sync with prod-ops for canary window. closing loop later today.
